scope: Bounded holder-page payment status persistence after separately verified result and durable proof
change: A holder work page remains limited to 32 leaves. Up to eight returned outcomes are committed in one locked ledger transaction. A failed or unacknowledged completion write stops further submissions; saved proofs and any published paid records are reconciled on the next pass.

localEvidence.focusedOutcomes: A 32-leaf page with one unresolved attempt and one missing durable proof records 30 paid and two verification-pending statuses with five ledger transactions: one page selection and four completion writes.
localEvidence.publicationFailure: An injected error after the first eight-result completion was published stopped the run after eight submit interfaces; a fresh store completed the other 24 without revisiting the first eight.
localEvidence.syntheticCohorts: Separate 1001-leaf SOL and paired mock-result plans each completed in 32 reopened-store passes and 159 store transactions, with 1001 submit interfaces and unchanged roots, amounts and global indexes.

limits: The cohort outcomes are mocked interfaces, not authenticated finalized signatures or wallet/custody deltas.

This reduces whole-ledger transaction and candidate-serialization frequency; it does not remove O(N) ledger reads or prove full normal-worker throughput under the production CPU, memory and deadline limits.
The live 1000-holder cap, on-chain contract, economic policy and signing admission remain unchanged.
Independent exact-source QA and all parent Mainnet release criteria remain open. No funding, signing, transaction or deployment occurred.
